other_conditions: Applicant must be an ordinarily resident of the Union territory of Puducherry and must not be ordinarily residing in any foreign nation during the natural calamity, lean season, or fishing ban period for which relief is issued
Beneficiary eligibility may be decided periodically by the Governing Body of the Pondicherry Fishermen Welfare and Distress Relief Society
Applicant or any member of the ration card must not be in regular service with Government/Quasi‑Government establishments or be a retired government pensioner
Benefit is not denied solely because the head of the family or any family member receives an Old Age Pension
Benefit is not restricted based on whether the fisherman owns mechanized, motorized or traditional fishing boats
benefits_summary: Each fisherman's family receives 100 kg of rice and a cash assistance of ₹750 during the fishing ban period.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
